svg.title: Integrating MaxManager into a ROM — three paths and the three names that must agree
svg.desc: Three integration paths: flash the systemless module MaxManager-V2.zip in Magisk or KernelSU; build the android/aosp kit into an AOSP tree with Soong files, an init service, a sepolicy domain and a privileged-permission allowlist; or use the android/kernelsu package for KernelSU Next. The binary path, the init service name and the SELinux domain must agree: /system/bin/sys.maxmanager-service, sys.maxmanager-service and u:r:maxmanager:s0. The binary is labelled maxmanager_exec by file_contexts.
